test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Separable
solution:
The correct answer is** "Indivisible".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** Here let's learn the meaning of the given words:

__
 
• **Separable -** able to be separated from each other

 
 
• ***Eg. ***The new team-based algorithm took substantially more time to run to completion than the original *separable *algorithm.
 
 
 
• Indivisible - not able to be separated from something else or into different parts
 
 
• ***Eg. ***He regards e-commerce as an *indivisible* part of modern retail.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here we will look at the meanings of the other words with some examples:

 
• **Branched -** a part of something larger

 
 
• ***Eg.*** Immunology is a *branch* of biological science.
 
 
 
• **Judicious -** having or showing reason and good judgment in making decisions
 
 
• ***Eg***. We should make *judicious* use of the resources available to us.
 
 
 
• **Liable -** having (legal) responsibility for something or someone
 
 
• ***Eg.*** The law holds parents* liable i*f a child does not attend school.
